correctness.rationale: The dual lexicographic matching computes the one positive homology degree and rank over the integers. Exact enumeration of all fixed unions of vertex orbits computes the signed Lefschetz sums; the orientation contribution of a union of b orbits is (−1)^(b−1). Taking the inner products with the four rational sign characters gives the multiplicities. Quotient ranks follow from exactness of finite-group coinvariants over Q.
